# Abyss

Abyss is an _ARG_-style horror mod that manipulates your world. It is only playable in **Hardcore mode**.

## Story

You enter your predetermined world in Hardcore mode. But you realize that something is watching you and wants to trap you. **Find a way out**.

## Important Information

The mod contains **gore** (not graphic), **screamers**, and **loud sounds**. It is not recommended for players under **12 years** of age.
The mod **modifies** your **game session** and your **computer**.
Here’s what the mod can do:
- Freeze your screen
- Turn off one of your external monitors
- Minimize windows
- Change the wallpaper
- Add .txt files.

All of this is managed by a _.vbs_ file _(game.vbs)_ created when the game launches.
You can edit it to change settings.

_Moeworth Studios accepts no liability in the event of failure to comply with certain rules set for the mod at game launch._
